universal_lens: Concurrent validity of AI player tracking via broadcast footage maps to stochastic process alignment under observational noise. Temporal-spatial alignment of multi-camera AI tracking datasets via phase shift and rotation minimization for concurrent validity assessment.
gsi_mapping: Bayesian inference of tracking accuracy uses RMSE and bias metrics to update belief over ground truth positions. Bayesian fusion of provider-specific positional and speed estimates using REML-linear mixed models to quantify uncertainty in player trajectory inference.
gse_mapping: Situationally grounded state transitions model player motion gaps through imputation and interpolation logic. Situational reasoning engine maps real-time player states through state-transition graphs informed by camera feed and resolution effects on detection accuracy.
